title.hr: Kratke antene: otpor zračenja, gubici i širina pojasa
title.en: Short antennas: radiation resistance, losses and bandwidth

concept.hr: Kratki dipol ugođen zavojnicom: malen, učinkovit, širokopojasan, biraj dva
concept.en: A short dipole tuned by a coil: small, efficient, broadband, pick two

summary.hr: Od 0,48 λ do 0,05 λ: otpor zračenja pada na 0,5 Ω, zavojnica poništava reaktanciju uz gubitke; stupanj djelovanja pada, Q raste, pojas SWR ≤ 2 sužava se.
summary.en: From 0.48 λ to 0.05 λ: the radiation resistance falls to 0.5 Ω, a coil cancels the reactance but loses; efficiency falls, Q rises, the SWR ≤ 2 band narrows.
